basic_info.description: **OPEN HOUSE 10:30A- 12:00P TUESDAY 10/29** 2749 Gough Street is a four (4) unit  building located in Cow Hollow  neighborhood between Filbert and Union  Streets. The property consists of two  (2) 1 bedroom-1 bath units and two (2)  2 bedroom-1 bath units. There are five  garage parking spaces. The building  sits on a large 25'x100' lot. The units are  separately metered for gas and electric.
